detail_text: Specifically, a summary listing of Biological Product Deviation Reports (BPDRs), covering the period of 1 July 2009-15 August 2010, had eighteen (18) BPDRs. Exception Detail Report, No. E- 0720636, logged 12/30/2009, involved thirty-one (31), imported Red Blood Cell units, Leukoreduced. A discrepancy, involving the temperature upon initial receipt of the units, was discovered after the units had been distributed. All31 units had been distributed to the same consignee. The Material Review Board (MRB) determination was to recall all31 units. On 24 August 2009, the Donor & Client Support Center in Charlotte, NC assumed responsibility of the Consignee Notification functions for The American National Red Cross, Northern California Region. A request was made by FDA, 09/08/2010, to review the documentation for Consignee Notification and all supporting documentation of product disposition. It was discovered that the supporting documentation of final disposition from the consignee could not be located. The Consignee was contacted for an additional copy, which was provided on 09/09/2010. It was then discovered that eight (8) of the 31 final dispositions on the Component Status Change Record (CSCR) Form had not been correctly filled out. T he CSCR had initially indicated that a ll 31 u nits had been destroyed. H owever, 8 of the units had actually been transfused. R eview by the Process Verifier, documented 03/04/2010, failed to identify these discrepancies. C orrective actions were initiated. EMPUlYEE(S) SIGNA lURE

FDA는 09/08/2010에 수하인 통지 문서와 제품 처분에 관한 모든 증빙 문서의 검토를 요청했다. 수하인의 최종 처분 증빙 문서를 찾을 수 없는 것으로 확인되었다. 수하인에게 연락하여 추가 사본을 요청했고, 09/09/2010에 제공받았다. 이후 혈액성분 상태 변경 기록(CSCR) 양식의 31건의 최종 처분 중 여덟(8) 건이 정확하게 작성되지 않은 것으로 확인되었다. CSCR에는 처음에 31 단위 모두가 폐기된 것으로 기재되어 있었다. 그러나 실제로는 8 단위가 수혈되었다. 03/04/2010에 문서화된 공정 검증자의 검토는 이러한 불일치를 확인하지 못했다. 시정조치가 시작되었다. EMPUlYEE(S) SIGNA lURE

detail_text: Specifically, A) The procedure "_ Investigation and Reporting of Incidents and Deviations" was not followed. For Example: 1) Deviation 'Report # was initiated because offoreign material floating in the product Thiamine. The firm's Quality Assurance did not document the following requirements from the procedure: a) Identify the cause ofthe deviation and final conclusion based on the investigation conducted and information collected. The following was not followed or completed by QA as required procedurally: a) Examine other batches ofproduct manufactured before/after using the same equipment or by the same employee. b) Consider how the deviation affects the disposition ofthe batch from the Regulatory, Compliance, Validation, Stability and Quality Aspects. B) The Procedure for issuing an NADAl ANADA Field Alert Report was not followed. Procedure "Records and Reports, Use ofForm FDA 1932" requires reporting to the FDA District Office within three working days of first becoming aware of information pertaining to product and manufacturing defects that may result in serious adverse drug events. This was not performed. For example: 1) A Field Alert report was not filed within three days for Thiamine 250 mL, lot 7060828 released to market 10/24/07, which contained particulate matter. The DOS was discovered on 1/8/09. The form used to report this Field Alert to FDA reads "Date Report Received 1/12/09" and it was not reported to FDA until "1/15/08". The 1/12/09 date would have met the three business day requirement, however no justification could be provided for the use of this date. Additionally, the FDA form 1932 was filled out incorrectly in that the year of 1/15/08 recorded as "DATE SENT TO FDA" appears to be incorrect in that it was actually sent in 2009 on January 15. 2) A Field Alert report was not filed within three days for Iron Dextran 200 mg, lot 7020186, released to market 3/21/07, which contained particulate matter. The ODS was discovered on 3/11/08. The form used to report this Field Alert to FDA reads "Date Report Received 3/21/08" and it was not reported to FDA until 3/26/08. This 2/21/08 date would have met the three business day requirement, however no justification could be provided for the use of this date. 3) A Field Alert report was not filed within three days for Gentamicin Sulfate injection 100 mg/mL, lot 7030475 released to market 4/12/07, and 7081139 released to market 8/30/07, with the amounts of. ingredients in the formulation transposed. It is unknown when this was discovered, but it was reported to FDA on 2/5/09. This incorrect formula with ingredients transposed had been used since the product was brought into the facility in June of 2001. 4) A Field Alert report was not filed within three days for Levothyroxine Sodium Tablets 0.2 mg, 0.5 mg, and 0.8 mg per tablet. The firm was aware ofthe problem as they had received. complaints between 12/18/07 and 8/18/08. The filed alert was not reported to FDA until August 20, 2008. A filed alert was reported to FDA March 31, 2009 during the inspection for lot 70304660.5 mg, released to market 9/5/2007. This Field Alert failed to include additional lots of tablets which the FDA uncovered during the inspection which had defects including various unidentified spots, and "fingernail" defects. See observation 3c for details. C) A production employee failed to follow procedure, "Batch Formulation Procedures". Step 1 e requires the employee to rinse a hose for. seconds before use. An Employee in the formulation room was observed to drop a clean hose on the wet floor drain and then gave it a quick squirt with hot WFI before connecting it to the tank and transferring lot, not yet released to market, to another tank. This quick squirt appeared to be less than. seconds. Additionally, the production employee had been trained on this procedure in December of 2008. The procedure requires the study be conducted under dynamic conditions, yet personnel involved in routine manufacture of sterile products in the aseptic core were absent from the airflow studies. detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, A) "_ 사고 및 일탈의 조사와 보고" 절차를 따르지 않았다. 예를 들어: 1) Thiamine 제품에 이물질이 떠 있어 일탈 보고서 #가 개시되었다. 귀사 품질 보증 부서는 절차상의 다음 요구사항을 문서화하지 않았다. a) 수행한 조사와 수집한 정보를 바탕으로 일탈 원인과 최종 결론을 확인한다. 이 일탈 보고서에는 일탈 원인이 문서화되거나 정당화되지 않았다. b) 정당화와 문서화를 포함하여 유사한 일탈의 재발을 방지하는 데 필요한 시정조치를 개략적으로 기술한다. 2) 무균 WFI, USP의 미립자 ODS 결과를 조사하기 위해 일탈 보고서 DR#가 개시되었다. 해당 로트는 12/8/08 시장 출하된 809110F, 12/5/08 시장 출하된 809123F, 12/8/08 시장 출하된 810124F [redacted], 아직 시장 출하되지 않은 로트 및 1/15/09 시장 출하된 8100727이다. QA는 절차에서 요구하는 다음 사항을 따르거나 완료하지 않았다. a) 같은 장비 또는 같은 작업자가 전후에 제조한 다른 제품 배치를 검사한다. b) 규제, 규정 준수, 밸리데이션, 안정성 및 품질 측면에서 일탈이 배치 처분에 미치는 영향을 고려한다. B) NADAl ANADA 현장 경고 보고서 발행 절차를 따르지 않았다.
